content.title: Recommended diagnostic tests in all patients with suspected chronic heart failure

recommended_tests.test: Routine blood tests for comorbidities (including full blood count, urea and electrolytes, thyroid function, fasting glucose and HbA1c, lipids, iron status [TSAT and ferritin])

footnotes.c: References are listed in section 4.2 for this item.

genes.context: BNP/NT-proBNP is listed multiple times as a recommended diagnostic test for suspected chronic heart failure and is defined in the footnote as B-type natriuretic peptide / N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (encoded by NPPB).
